csv_project_name: CM for Calvet Headquarters Electrical Upgrade
csv_agency: State of California Department of General Services
csv_scope_of_work: The Department of General Services (DGS), Real Estate Services Division (RESD), Project Management and Development Branch (PMDB) is requesting Statements of Qualifications (SOQ) from Construction Management firms. The successful firm shall provide professional construction management (CM) services and additional services. includes, but is not limited to: Interior work within portions of an existing building. Electrical upgrades include disconnecting and replacement of existing switchgear, switchboards, distribution panelboards, transformers, panelboards, disconnect switches, busway, and selective feeders throughout, and replacement of busway from SMUD vault to main electrical room.

title: Construction Management for Calvet Headquarters Electrical Upgrade
short_description: Construction management services for a headquarters building electrical upgrade in Sacramento.
project_scope: Interior work within portions of an existing building at the Calvet Headquarters in Sacramento. The project includes electrical upgrades consisting of disconnecting and replacing existing switchgear, switchboards, distribution panelboards, transformers, panelboards, disconnect switches, busway, and selective feeders throughout, as well as replacing the busway from the SMUD vault to the main electrical room. Total construction cost is stated as 16.5 million.
services: Construction management services and additional professional services for an electrical upgrade project; requested disciplines include design-build/developer, construction/project management, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, and mechanical engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a construction management procurement, not structural or bridge design.
- Scope is an electrical upgrade inside an existing administrative building.
- No indication of complex load-bearing structures, long spans, bridges, roofs, or special structures.
- Falls under low-interest categories for sbp such as pure project management and building services-oriented work.
fee_explanation: No explicit design or engineering fee for sbp-relevant structural services is stated. The notice is for construction management services only.
references_qualifications: Statements of Qualifications are requested from construction management firms. Requested disciplines include design-build/developer, construction/project management, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, and mechanical engineering. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: State of California, Department of General Services, Real Estate Services Division, Project Management and Development Branch, Sacramento, CA. Contact: Sandy Gomez. Email: sandra.gomez@dgs.ca.gov. Phone: 916-376-5000. Website: https://caleprocure.ca.gov/event/7760/0000039627
notes: Project #: 868275. AgencyID: 491. Contract duration: 15. Renewable: No. Stage: RFP/RFQ. Solicitation documents available online. Although categorized under buildings, the project is an interior electrical infrastructure upgrade rather than a structural building design commission.
